# YW Physical Therapy

> YW Physical Therapy PLLC is a one-on-one physical therapy practice in Midtown Manhattan near Penn Station, led by Yu-Kuang Wu, PT, PhD. The website describes physical therapy, movement analysis, shockwave therapy, recovery-focused wellness services, clinic logistics, and pricing.

Last updated: 2026-09-23
